pages.text: Attacking a living target without wither applies Wither I for 1–5 seconds. The applying attack is consumed by this interaction.
pages.title: Wither Hit

pages.text: $(bold)Mob sources$()$(br)Wither Skeleton, Wither.$(br2)Collect their organic matter, then analyze, extract, decode, and infuse the gene. Server configuration can disable individual genes.
